summary:
The plan is in plan.md. It gives each of the eight plots exact block coordinates. Every house uses the same layout: storeys at y1–2 and y4–5 with ground floors level with the street, a front gable, a hip or a lean-to roof, and front doors on the south (high z) as the brief says.
The variety reads as the Presidio: a white house with a steep red roof, a porch and a brick chimney; a cream Mission duplex with a curved front parapet and two doors; a white garage and shed with dark grey roofs; a brick barracks with a two-storey white colonnade; a Spanish hall with an arched front arcade and a two-bell gable over its door; and a white Colonial house with green shutters, dormers and chimneys at both ends.
The battery is a low concrete block behind a grassy north slope rising to a parapet, with two round gun pits with iron rings, magazine doors and a stair on the south side, kept within y5; no roof dry-runs were done yet, since there's no build file, and no block named "chain" is used. Eight Presidio modules (white-wood houses, Mission duplex, garage, shed, brick barracks with colonnade, Spanish Colonial hall with belfry, officers' house, Endicott battery) on the architect's grid.
elements.md and plan.md (palette, 22 vocab helpers, rooms, parts) are written.
Six parts follow the trades: shells, roofs, chimneys, openings and trim, battery, lighting and grounds.

parts.name: Masonry shells
parts.scope: Walls, floors and plinths of all eight plots: plots 0-6 bodies per FACADES with corner_boards, string_course and quoins, interior floors, nave and aisles of plot 5, and openings left as air. Check the ground box stays within each plot.

parts.name: Roofs
parts.scope: All ROOFS rows: roof.json for plots 0,1,2,4,5,6, and the hand roofs (porches, pyramid_cap, aisle lean-tos, arcade, dormers, mission_parapet). Keep chimney cells in keep boxes.

parts.name: Chimneys
parts.scope: Call chimney() directly, after the roofs, for plots 0, 4 west and east, 6 west and east, per the architect's table; one lit campfire each; count them with $MCD fit.

parts.name: Openings and trim
parts.scope: All glass_pane windows, doors (door, double), shutters, door hoods, porches and colonnades, arches, the belfry with its two bells, the rose window and the rust-free trim; per OPENINGS.

parts.name: Coastal battery
parts.scope: Plot 7 complete: emplacement, parapet, glacis, side mounds, banquette, gun pits with rings, magazines with iron doors, deck stair, iron-bar rail, rust cells; vocab weathered_concrete, glacis, gun_pit, magazine_door, deck_stair.

parts.name: Lighting and grounds
parts.scope: Lanterns in every room and by every door, lamp posts on the battery deck and by the glacis so no spawn, and apron paths. Keep the ground within the 1-block apron limits and inside the plots.

recruit.why: Brick, stucco and weathered concrete walls with plinths, quoins and bands.
Hip, gable and pyramid roofs in clay tile and slate with overhangs and verges.
Five brick chimneys with lit hearths and walled flues.
Windows, doors, shutters, hoods and porches.
Hall belfry with the two bells.
Endicott battery: parapet, gun pits, magazines, deck stair.
No dark cells, lamps by doors and on the battery deck.
Aprons, paths and grass for the glacis.
